text:
maria-ops: FYI Acme Health flagged invoice OH-2026-0421. AP sees two separate platform fee lines and is refusing to auto-post. They asked for clarification before payment.

sam-fin: I pulled the file. Totals match the SOW but the export shows PLATFORM_SERVICE and a separate negative PLATFORM_LEGACY_ADJ. Do we have an approval record for that credit?

kelly-ar: @maria-ops paste the relevant invoice lines? AP will want a single billed line or a documented "contract credit". We usually avoid the split on the customer-facing invoice.

maria-ops: Snippet (redacted):
```
Line 12: PLATFORM_SERVICE - $120,000 - SKU: PF-ENT-2025
Line 13: PLATFORM_LEGACY_ADJ - ($12,000) - SKU: PF-LEGACY-CREDIT
Line 14: SUPPORT_TIER_GOLD - $30,000 - SKU: SUP-GOLD
Total due: $138,000
```
Acme says the negative line doesn't clearly state "contract credit" and their AP needs an approval reference.

sam-fin: That negative matches the migration credit we approved for legacy billing consolidation. Need to find the approval ID and confirm it was meant to be netted.

kelly-ar: I found an AR note: Approval APPR-2025-1128 (Jordan CS) for $12,000 "Platform consolidation credit - Acme Health" dated 2025-12-18. AR has the approval PDF on file.

jordan-cs: Confirmed, I approved APPR-2025-1128. I can email the approval confirmation to Acme AP and cc billing.

billing-bot: Billing job 2026-04-20-19:03 completed. Export rule: credit lines for PF-LEGACY-CREDIT are emitted as separate line items. Created ticket BILL-7842.

sam-fin: Proposed actions: 1) @kelly-ar attach APPR-2025-1128 PDF to thread, 2) @billing-ops please reissue OH-2026-0421 with a single line "Platform Fee (net of migration credit)" and memo "APPR-2025-1128" OR send a cover letter with the approval attached, 3) I'll update GL mapping so AR posts to single platform revenue account.

kelly-ar: Uploading approval PDF to AR system and will paste the internal link here shortly (link omitted). Filename: APPR-2025-1128-Acme-PlatformCredit.pdf.

billing-bot: BILL-7842 assigned to @billing-ops. ETA for corrected invoice reissue: 2 business days. Will include consolidated line and reference to APPR-2025-1128 in memo.

maria-ops: Thanks everyone. I'll notify Acme contact that a corrected invoice and formal approval email are coming so AP doesn't hold the payment. :pray:
notes: thread contains approval/credit discussion and billing ticket for reissue
